title: Scenario-Based Top-1 Recommendations
description: Produce a Top-1 recommendation for EACH of the 4 scenarios, based on the data collected by all other task cards. Each recommendation must include: (1) The single best GPU/hardware choice for that scenario, (2) Why it beats all alternatives (with specific numbers), (3) Total cost including any required accessories (PSU, eGPU enclosure, etc.), (4) Expected performance for the user's specific workload (35B model inference), (5) Trade-offs the user accepts with this choice, (6) Alternative if the recommended item is unavailable. The 4 scenarios: S1 Entry-Budget (<$800): best performance per dollar, likely used/refurb market. S2 Mid-Range ($800-$1500): sweet spot for value. S3 High-End (>$1500): best absolute performance, no budget constraint. S4 eGPU Branch: laptop user wanting external GPU — evaluate eGPU enclosures + any compatible GPU vs built-in desktop. For each scenario, the recommendation must be justified by the cost-performance formula from 02-r1-cost-performance-formula. Cross-check that the recommended item is actually available for purchase (check retailer stock status).
